subject: [Webinar] Invite cadence, audience split, & RSVP link mapping
body:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Khan <amir.khan@acmecloud.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@aquila.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: [Webinar] Invite cadence, audience split, & RSVP link mapping

Hi team — kicking this thread off to lock the final invite plan for the March 10 webinar with Acme Cloud ("Low-latency LLMs at scale"). Key asks: confirm audience splits, subject line variants, RSVP/UTM mapping, and reminder cadence. Attached: audience_split_csv.csv and invite_graphic_v3.png.

Proposed high-level: 
- Launch invite (Day 0) to warm prospects + customers (split A/B subject)
- 3 reminder pulses (Day 3 short reminder, Day 7 product-led reminder with customer quote, Day 10 final day — calendar push)
- Post-webinar follow-up to registrants and no-shows

Draft subject A: "How Acme and Redwood cut LLM inference costs by 3x — Mar 10"
Draft subject B: "Reduce inference latency and cost — Live demo with Acme Cloud"

UTM/RSVP mapping (draft):
- Invite link (email): https://redwood.com/webinar/rlm-mar10?utm_source=email&utm_medium=invite&utm_campaign=acme_mar10_A (A/B switch only on subject)
- Reminder 1: utm_campaign=acme_mar10_rem1
- Reminder 2: utm_campaign=acme_mar10_rem2
- Final: utm_campaign=acme_mar10_final

Audience splits attached; main segments: 
1) Acme's Tier-1 prospects (sent from Amir) — seed list (5k)
2) Redwood warm leads (Marketing list) — Marissa owns selections (12k)
3) Existing customers using Redwood Dedicated — Grace owns outreach (600)

Questions for the thread: 
- Marissa: can you confirm suppression against last-90-day webinar attendees?
- Grace: can you validate customer-facing copy (we need a strong customer quote in Remind 2)?
- Ben: partner co-brand asset (logo placement) and marketplace CTA — any restrictions?

Thanks — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: invite_graphic_v3.png (image/png), audience_split_csv.csv (text/csv))

On Sat, Jan 30, 2027 at 09:12, Diego Fernandez wrote:
> Hi team — kicking this thread off to lock the final invite plan for the March 10 webinar with Acme Cloud...

Agree with the cadence. Quick answers: 
- Suppression: yes — we’ll exclude last 90 days + active churn rehab list. I have the suppression export ready; attaching utm_mapping_sheet.xlsx for the final link matrix.
- Subject lines: I vote for Subject B for the Acme prospects and Subject A for Redwood warm leads (subject performance historically: benefit-led works better with partners).
- Timing: send initial at 10am PT on Mar 1. Reminders at 10am PT on Mar 4, Mar 8, and Mar 10 (8am PT final day calendar push).

Action: I’ll push the lists to Pardot and share the suppression report by EOD Tue.

Marissa
Growth Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: utm_mapping_sheet.xlsx)

Diego/Marissa — I pulled the 3 customer quotes for reminder 2. Best candidate is a short quote from Acme (Sara Liu) about latency improvements. I’ve drafted copy below — please review: 

Reminder 2 copy (product/customer): 
"See how Acme cut 99th-percentile latency by 40% and dropped per-request costs using Redwood’s Dedicated pools. Join our live demo and Q&A on Mar 10."

Also: for customers we should add a line about dedicated support availability and add a small section for "Ask an engineer" (allocating 15 minutes at the end for live troubleshooting).

I’ll send the exact quote once Sara confirms.

Grace
Director, Developer Marketing | Redwood Inference
